canonicalReview.reconciliationSummary: Canonical review uses the single reviewer result from epic-reviewer-1.
crossStoryFindings: Story 2 live-capture bootstrapping and Story 5 attach/import conflict in the production extension seam: the extension eagerly creates a managed thread on session lifecycle events, which prevents later historical attach for that same session.

Story 5's core import service supports active-branch resolution, but the registered `/lh-attach` command does not pass the live session-manager context, so branched-session support exists below the production command path but not at the operator entrypoint.
architectureFindings: PI Runtime Integration drifts from the tech design contract that active-path import should come from `SessionManager.getBranch()` on the current leaf; `/lh-attach` falls back to raw file ambiguity detection instead.

Verification architecture drifts from the test plan: `verify-all` is green without any `*.integration.test.ts` files, so the epic gate does not provide the planned reopen/import/concurrency/temp-file smoke coverage.
epicCoverageAssessment: `npm run verify` passed with 104 unit tests covering store, capture, turn, import, repair, fixture, and command-helper behavior.
The highest-risk gap is the production `/lh-attach` seam: service-level import behavior exists, but attach-after-live-start and branched-session attach are broken in the registered extension path.

The planned `file-thread-store.integration.test.ts` suite from the test plan is absent, so `verify-all` does not exercise process-style reopen, file-path import, overlapping capture serialization, or stale-temp recovery.
productionPathFindings: Production live-capture bootstrapping preempts attach: once a session lifecycle event is captured, `/lh-attach` rejects the same session as already managed instead of importing its prior history.
Production `/lh-attach` ignores the live `SessionManager` branch context, so branched sessions fail with `IMPORT_PATH_AMBIGUOUS` even when the current leaf is known in the running session.
The epic gate is effectively a placeholder for integration coverage because `test:integration` exits success when no integration tests exist.

blockingFindings.title: `/lh-attach` ignores current-branch context and fails on branched sessions
blockingFindings.evidence: The tech design says active-path import must come from `SessionManager.getBranch()` using the current leaf (`docs/spec-build/epics/01-session-context-store/tech-design.md:62-63`). `executeAttachCommand` passes only `store`, `target`, and `sessionFilePath` into `attachExistingPiSession`, omitting both `activeLeafId` and `sessionManager` (`src/context-steward/pi/pi-extension.ts:304-320`), even though `attachExistingPiSession` supports them (`src/context-steward/services/import-service.ts:297-302`). The same file proves the context is available because `executeFixtureCommand` does pass `activeLeafIdFromContext(input.ctx)` and `importSessionManagerFromContext(input.ctx)` for PI-session fixture imports (`src/context-steward/pi/pi-extension.ts:449-457`). In a direct repro with a branched session and live `getLeafId()/getBranch()` available, `lh-attach` still failed with `IMPORT_PATH_AMBIGUOUS` instead of importing the active branch.

blockingFindings.title: Live extension bootstrap makes `/lh-attach` unusable for already-open PI sessions
blockingFindings.evidence: `registerContextStewardExtension` wires `session_start`, `session_before_switch`, `session_shutdown`, `turn_start`, `turn_end`, and `message_end` through `captureEvent`, which calls `ensureActiveThread` and `openOrCreateManagedThread` before any command path (`src/context-steward/pi/pi-extension.ts:563-618`). `/lh-attach` then delegates to `attachExistingPiSession`, and that service immediately returns `TARGET_ASSOCIATION_CONFLICT` when a thread already exists for the target (`src/context-steward/pi/pi-extension.ts:304-320`, `src/context-steward/services/import-service.ts:284-295`). In a direct repro against the exported extension, emitting `session_start` and then invoking `lh-attach` produced `Attach failed ... already managed ... [TARGET_ASSOCIATION_CONFLICT]`. That conflicts with the attach/import flow required by `epic.md` (`docs/spec-build/epics/01-session-context-store/epic.md:331-340`, `344-357`, `411-424`).

nonBlockingFindings.title: `verify-all` passes without running the planned integration suite
nonBlockingFindings.evidence: The test plan says the epic gate should run `file-thread-store.integration.test.ts` smoke coverage for reopen, file-path import, overlapping capture serialization, and stale temp-file recovery (`docs/spec-build/epics/01-session-context-store/test-plan.md:226-235`). `package.json` routes `test:integration` through `scripts/run-node-tests.mjs integration` (`package.json:16-18`), and that runner exits 0 when the matching file set is empty (`scripts/run-node-tests.mjs:39-43`). The repo currently has no `*.integration.test.ts` files under `tests/`, and the observed `npm run verify-all` output ended with `No integration tests found.`

unresolvedItems: Decide whether existing-session attach should defer automatic thread creation until import runs, or whether attach must be allowed to hydrate an already-created empty thread without violating source-order and import-range guarantees.
Decide whether the project wants `test:integration` to fail closed when the suite is empty, or whether a separate epic-smoke harness will replace the missing `*.integration.test.ts` coverage.
